title: 8 Rules for the First 30 Days After a Layoff

items.headline: Take care of yourself first.
items.body: Rest, exercise, eat. The company that let you go couldn't care less about your well-being. So you have to.

items.headline: Tell your wife first.
items.body: She's on your team, and this moment can make or break a marriage. Single? Stay your ass away from dating. Your aura is off.

items.headline: Wake up grateful. Go to sleep accomplished.
items.body: Gratitude journal every morning. Three to five goals for tomorrow every night, and carry over what you didn't finish.

items.headline: Keep one thing that's yours.
items.body: For me it was the gym. Don't lose yourself in the BS.

items.headline: NETWORK. Seriously.
items.body: Talk to everyone you know. I got my current job through networking, not a job board.

items.headline: Gather every resource you can.
items.body: Call every creditor, defer the loans, find side income. Idleness is the enemy.

items.headline: Volunteer.
items.body: You'll feel like a person again, and you may meet the person who hires you.

items.headline: Take one day off from all of it.
items.body: Job hunting burns you out fast. F*** the job search, just for one day.
